surface_mechanism_description: The surface reactions involve the adsorption of Pb-precursor and Ti-precursor followed by water pulse to regenerate OH sites. The PbO and TiO2 layers are formed through surface reactions with the oxidant H2O. The growth rate of the PTO film is influenced by the catalytic effect of the TiO2 layer on the PbO layer.
evidence: The text describes the ALD process for PTO thin films using Pb-precursor and Ti-precursor with H2O as oxidant. It mentions the formation of PbO and TiO2 layers through surface reactions with H2O. The catalytic effect of the TiO2 layer on the PbO layer is noted, and the presence of surface hydroxyls is implied through the water pulse step.
